notes: Layered module structure, platform libraries, health, decimals, API client and Architecture page; real hosting and sign-in still open. See COMPLETION/01.01.md

title: Database Foundation, Migration Framework & Data Integrity
notes: Integrity suite and page, idempotency, migration tooling, back-fill framework, backup and restore, test-data generator. See COMPLETION/01.02.md

title: System Configuration, Financial Years & Numbering Series
notes: Company settings, financial years and periods, numbering service, parameters, holidays, stand-in approvals, five pages. See COMPLETION/01.03.md

title: Domain Event Bus, Transactional Outbox & Background Job Scheduler
notes: Relay, inbox, retries, dead letters, replay, job runner, cron scheduler, four console pages. See COMPLETION/01.04.md

title: File Storage & Secure Attachment Service
notes: Upload (multipart and resumable), type and content checks, scan jobs and quarantine, signed links, access by linked record, settings with approval, upload component. No real ClamAV or S3 yet (D-031, D-033). See COMPLETION/01.05.md

title: Central Calculation Engine & Formula Registry
notes: Calculation language, versioned formula registry with approval, shadow mode, traces, unit conversion, four built-in formulas with golden outputs, four pages. Only the sample bill calls the engine so far (D-040). See COMPLETION/01.06.md

title: Observability, Logging, Health Checks & Performance Baseline
notes: Redacted JSON logs with correlation ID through events and jobs, own tracer (OTLP export), metrics and /metrics, objectives and alert rules with maker-checker, browser error reporting, Operations Health page, load-test baseline. Alert senders not connected (D-047). See COMPLETION/01.07.md

title: Integration Hub & External Connector Framework
notes: Connector registry, AES-256-GCM credential vault with staged approval, provider abstraction, call wrapper with timeout/retry/circuit breaker/rate limit, redacted call log, signed webhooks with replay protection, health checks, three pages. Dedicated providers belong to later parts (D-052). See COMPLETION/01.08.md

title: Authentication, Sessions, MFA & Password Policy
notes: Argon2id with legacy hash upgrade, sessions with refresh rotation and reuse detection, TOTP/SMS/backup-code MFA enforced for privileged roles, lockout and CAPTCHA, password policy, devices and PIN, suspicious-login alerts, five pages. SSO is configuration only (D-061); users are a thin store (D-059). See COMPLETION/02.01.md

title: Organisation Hierarchy — Company, Branch, Department, Project & Site Master
notes: Companies, branches and regions, departments to any depth, designations, projects, sites with circle and polygon geofences (shared geometry, edge-tolerance test), locations, cost and profit centres, effective-dated assignments with a daily job, activation by PD then PCMGR and geofence change by SYSADM through approval, deactivation blockers registry, org chart with move and undo, context switcher

title: User Management, Employee Linking & Onboarding State
notes: Users with lifecycle (invited, onboarding, active, suspended, deactivated), invitations by email/text/WhatsApp with expiry and resend, restricted onboarding state enforced by one gate, role requests through approval with grant history, deactivation wizard handing approvals and organisation roles to a successor, duplicate detection, CSV import with row errors, bulk invite and suspend, profile with photo and signature through the document service

title: Role & Permission Engine (RBAC + ABAC, Scopes, Field Masking) and Role Templates
notes: One engine computes grants per request: roles held company-wide or by project, site, branch, department or own records, dated, deny beats allow, confidentiality clearance, sensitive-field masks, reporting hierarchy rule; 44 role templates (23 owner roles) seeded and locked, custom copies changed only by approval; scope enforced on projects, sites, cost centres and sample documents; effective-permission explainer; legacy access comparison with zero unintended differences; Can helper

title: Segregation of Duties, Privileged Access & Access Reviews
notes: Rule engine with the ten standard rules (block, warn, detect) enforced when a role is given, when an elevation is asked for and when a person acts on a document; violation report with remediation (take a role away or accept the risk); time-boxed elevated access with manager, IT administrator and CFO approval, ended by the clock and logged; access review campaigns that cannot close until every line is decided and apply the revokes; dormant account detection with suspension by policy

title: Audit Trail Engine & Security Event Log
notes: Hash-chained append-only audit trail (every audit row chained beside the existing log, triggers refuse update and delete), field-level diffs with sensitive values masked, nightly verification that raises a critical security event on tampering, security event log fed by domain events, sign-in failures, refused requests and sensitive exports, export and print logging, sealed monthly segments, legacy log chained and sign-in failures imported, Audit Explorer, Security Events and a Record History component

title: Secure Request Pipeline, Route Registry, Secrets & Security Headers
notes: Route registry: every one of 278 routes declared with guard, permission, scope, rate class and audit flag, checked at start-up (staging and production refuse an undeclared route) and in CI; central Authorise stage; self-test of every route (401 without sign-in, 403 without permission); security headers with a CSP that blocks injected scripts, strict CORS and CSRF guard; rate limits by class and address or person from approved settings; export controls with approval above 1,000 people; room guard and act-as helpers; vault key rotation; threat model and secrets procedures; Route Registry and Security Settings pages

title: Design Tokens, Themes, Typography & Iconography
notes: Design tokens from one JSON source into CSS variables and a Tailwind preset (checked in the regression); light, dark and high-contrast themes following the device on a first visit and saved per person; comfortable and compact densities; self-hosted IBM Plex Sans, Devanagari and Mono; icon registry behind one Icon component with original construction glyphs; status semantics; contrast report (135 pairs pass AA, high contrast AAA); lint rule against hard-coded colours; Design System page and Appearance in My Profile

title: Form Components & Data-Entry Framework
notes: Field components for every FR-01 type with read-only as text; sections, sticky action bar, unsaved-changes guard; shared Zod validation with an error summary and server errors on fields; context auto-fill; dependent lookups through one lookup contract (100k rows under 300 ms); line grid with keyboard entry and paste from Excel; server drafts with autosave and My Drafts; duplicate checks; create-from; form definitions; reference Sample Material Request numbered at submit with server-recomputed amounts; Form Components gallery

title: Data Table & List Report Component
notes: List Report contract (defineList: search, filter operators, sort, 25-200 pages, totals of the filtered set) and component (status chips, my records, FY date presets, filter builder, saved personal/shared views, column chooser kept per person, sticky header, frozen column, resize, windowed rows, bulk actions with results, row links and actions, cards under 768 px); server exports CSV/XLSX/PDF with footer, masks and inert formulas, background jobs and My Exports; reference register Sample Material Requests migrated; commercial total masked for non-commercial roles

title: Object Page, Approval Panel, Attachments, Timeline & Feedback States
notes: Object Page with sticky header, server-decided actions and tabs; approval panel (steps, clock, decisions, history) on the 01.03 engine with the reference record routed through it; attachment panel with required-document checklist; merged timeline; discussion with mentions; related records; amendment comparison; print; toasts, banners, confirmation with reason codes, progress dialog, offline banner and standard states; reference Sample Material Request on the Object Page; commercial values masked on every path

title: Application Shell, Navigation Registry & Context Switcher
notes: Application shell with header, registry-built sidebar, breadcrumbs, quick create, bell, account menu and keyboard; navigation registry in the database filtered by permission and flag, changed by request and approval; working context kept per person that narrows lists and fills forms; route guards for permission, flag and context; launchpad with tiles, favourites, recent records and pending work; technical console apart from business menus; all 58 pages in the registry

title: Responsive Layouts, PWA & Device Capabilities
notes: Phone bottom navigation, tablet rail and full sidebar; installable app (manifest, icons, service worker, install and update notices) that opens offline; device layer for camera with compression and kept EXIF, one-time position with notice and mock hints, QR and barcode scanner with resolver, vibration, Web Push with node:crypto, low-bandwidth mode; Field Home and Scan pages; swipe actions and pull to refresh; 44 px targets; every page swept at 360 px

title: Dashboard & Widget Framework and My Workspace
notes: Widget registry and one permission-checked data endpoint for every module; 23 widgets (KPI with trend and target, bar, stacked, line, area, donut, gauge, heat map, Gantt, table, alerts, lists, map, calendar, quick actions, notice); own SVG chart library with tooltip, legend, table fallback, CSV and PNG; My Work, Requests Overview and Dashboard Designer; global project, site and period filters with financial-year presets; drill-down to the list with the same filters; personal layout on the server with drag-and-drop and keyboard moves; role defaults as maker-checker requests

title: Global Search & Command Palette
notes: Search index service with a registry modules fill (12 kinds), kept current by domain events and a five-minute catch-up; permission- and scope-safe search with every hit read again from its record; document-number, partial, sound (Hindi and Latin) and typing-mistake matching; sensitive values searched only by roles that see them; command palette on Ctrl/Cmd+K with grouped records, pages and 16 actions; Advanced Search with filters, saved filters and CSV; Search Administration with rebuild per kind and analytics of searches that found nothing
